release_read.basis: Q3 sales ($222.7m) were pre-announced and the GAAP loss of $(2.64) is the known settlement charge; the new lines are qualitative and lean positive: October patient shipments at a post-launch record and October daily referrals still above 75% of Q3's despite the PH-ILD stop, while the release neither restates nor withdraws the >$1bn 2027 ambition (no guidance at all), so the feared reset did not arrive in the release; the call (08:30 ET) is unread.

release.headline: Liquidia Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update

call.detail: Webcast 08:30 ET today; content not yet read.

recommendation.reason: Voorlopig: de cijfers waren al bekend en de nieuwe kwalitatieve punten (record leveringen in oktober, verwijzingen boven 75% van Q3) wijzen eerder omhoog, tegen de short in. Eruit bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Een duidelijk lagere voorbeurskoers zou het wachten tot later rechtvaardigen.
